% dcolumn's D columns: each cell's number as in the PDF, with its output
% separator, its math minus, and no separator in an integer or an empty
% cell, in tabular, longtable, tabular*, and tabularx, through a
% \newcolumntype, with two-sided and negative formats, under a
% \multicolumn header and booktabs rules, and in a footnote's size, a
% theorem, and sans-serif text. The separators of a column line up as
% in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{dcolumn,booktabs,longtable,tabularx,amsthm}
\newcolumntype{d}[1]{D{.}{.}{#1}}
\newcolumntype{E}{D{,}{\cdot}{-1}}
\newcolumntype{.}{D{.}{.}{-1}}
% esttab's star command
\newcommand\sym[1]{\ifmmode^{#1}\else\(^{#1}\)\fi}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Plain one & 1.25 \\
    Plain two & 10.5 \\
    Plain minus & -12.75 \\
    Plain empty & \\
    Plain integer & 3 \\
    Plain point & .5 \\
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{l d{3.2} d{-1}}
    \toprule
    Label & \multicolumn{1}{c}{Value} & \multicolumn{1}{c}{Other} \\
    \midrule
    Sided one & 123.45 & 0.125 \\
    Sided two & 1.5 & 42 \\
    Sided minus & -0.25 & -7.5 \\
    Sided dash & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & 9.75 \\
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{l E D{.}{,}{2}}
    Comma one & 3,14 & 1.5 \\
    Comma two & 2,718 & 200.25 \\
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{-3} D{.}{.}{-3}}
    \toprule
    & \multicolumn{2}{c}{Model} \\ \cmidrule(lr){2-3}
    Stars & \multicolumn{1}{c}{A} & \multicolumn{1}{c}{B} \\
    \midrule
    Stars one & 0.123^{***} & -0.5^{*} \\
    Stars error & (0.045) & (0.25) \\
    Stars sym & 1.25\sym{**} & 10.5 \\
    \multicolumn{2}{l}{Stars wide} & 0.75 \\
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{l . .}
    Dot one & 1.5 & 2.25 \\[3pt]
    Dot two & 10.25 & 3 \\
    Dot last & 2.5 & 30.5
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Multi one & 12.5 \\
    Multi two & \multicolumn{1}{D{.}{.}{2}}{1.5} \\
    Multi last & 2.5
\end{tabular}

\begin{longtable}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Long one & 1.25 \\
    Long two & 100.5 \\
\end{longtable}

\begin{tabular*}{0.6\textwidth}{@{\extracolsep{\fill}} l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Star one & 2.25 \\
    Star two & 30.5 \\
\end{tabular*}

\begin{tabularx}{0.6\textwidth}{X D{.}{.}{2}}
    X one & 4.25 \\
    X two & 40.5 \\
\end{tabularx}

{\footnotesize
\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{1}}
    Note one & 5.5 \\
    Note two & 50.25 \\
\end{tabular}\par}

\begin{theorem}
\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Theorem one & 6.25 \\
    Theorem two & 60.5 \\
\end{tabular}
\end{theorem}

{\sffamily
\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    Sans one & 7.25 \\
    Sans two & 70.5 \\
\end{tabular}\par}

Math after the tables: $x = 1$.
\end{document}
